newsitem.title: GERMANY: Compuserve sees Q2 loss up to $0.15/shr.
newsitem.headline: Compuserve sees Q2 loss up to $0.15/shr.

text.p: Compuserve Inc expects to post a loss of up to 15 cents a share in the second quarter of fiscal 1996/97, but turn around to a profit in the third and fourth quarters of the year, said Steven Stanbrook, president of international operations.
Stanbrook told a news conference here the U.S.-based online service, the world's second largest, expects to be profitable in the 1996/97 business year, which ends April 30, 1997.
Stanbrook ascribed the first and second quarter losses in 1996/97 to high investments, particularly in the U.S.
The company is already turning good profits in Europe, he said. Stanbrook was speaking at a news conference where Compuserve's German unit announced a new tie-up with Deutsche Telekom AG.
In the quarter to July 31, the company lost 32 cents a share, compared with a 36 cent profit in the year-earlier quarter.
